items.d: Anyone can buy steel and concrete and put up a building. The parts that hold it up are the ones you want done the same way every time: who logs in, who gets charged, who sees what.

items.q: I can't code. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes, if you are building with AI or with a developer.
items.d: We build the foundation and set it up so your AI keeps building on it. We do not build your whole product.

items.q: What do you need from me?
items.a: A 30-minute call and accounts in your own name.
items.d: Stripe for payments, and a place for your product and its data to live. Already building? We work inside your project. If not, we start a fresh one.

items.q: What if you miss the 48 hours?
items.a: You get all of your money back.
items.d: The clock is two working days from our call, for the scope we agreed on it.

items.a: No. It is yours from day one.
items.d: Your code, your data, your Stripe account. Any developer you hire can take it over. If we run it later, cancel anytime and take it all with you.

items.a: Build the part that makes it yours.
items.d: Your features, your design and a phone app are yours to build. It runs on your own accounts. You put it online with our written steps, or you have us run it.
